parts.text: I keep the shared picture of the airspace by working with the network of flight corridors between sites, the zones that group them, and the closures announced by the authorities. When the authorities announce planned closures with a start and end time, or sudden closures that apply at once, I enter them into the system. Since closures are often amended during the day, such as when an area is widened or an end time moves, I handle those changes while drones of several companies are already in the air. Afterwards, when a closure is entered, I want to know how much disruption it caused across customers.
